summary_en: 315,000 shares (12.92% of outstanding) purchased via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-08 at reference price of ¥1,595/share, aggregate ¥502.4M. Execution at open 08:45 JST. To offset near-term market impact from shareholder sale and enable flexible capital policy response.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-exchange self-share purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-08, PLAZA Holdings resolved to acquire 315,000 treasury shares (12.92% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) via off-exchange self-share purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3) at the reference price of ¥1,595 per share, for an aggregate consideration of ¥502,425,000. The purchase will be executed at 08:45 JST on 2026-06-08 via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 facility. The company stated the acquisition was undertaken to mitigate short-term market impact from a shareholder's intent to sell holdings and to enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. Results will be disclosed immediately following trade execution. The number of shares to be acquired will not be changed, though partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
